title: Authenticated users can read another user's profile
description: The profile endpoint accepts an arbitrary account identifier and returns the matching record without checking ownership.
root_cause: The handler trusts the path parameter as the caller's account identity.
intended_behavior: A signed-in user should only read their own profile unless an explicit administrative role is present.

trace.description: The request supplies the target user ID.
The database query returns the profile without an ownership predicate.

evidence.description: The handler selects by req.params.userId and does not compare it with the authenticated principal.

conditions.description: The caller has a valid account session.

execution.attacker_perspective: A standard authenticated user changes the requested identifier.
instructions: Sign in as a low-privilege user.
Request the profile route with another known user ID.
execution.observed_result: The response contains the other user's profile fields.

remediation.strategy: Derive the profile ID from the authenticated principal, or enforce an explicit owner-or-admin authorization check before querying.

likelihood.reason: The identifier is directly controlled by any authenticated caller.

impact.reason: Private profile data belonging to another user is disclosed.

confidence.reason: The route and query show the missing authorization check directly.

title: Webhook signature enforcement depends on deployment configuration
description: The visible handler has a signature verification branch, but the production secret binding is not represented in this repository.
claimed_root_cause: The verification branch may be bypassed when the webhook secret is empty.

trace.description: The route receives provider-controlled webhook payloads.
Verified events reach payment state updates.

evidence.description: The verification helper reads PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET from the runtime environment.

blockers: The deployed environment's PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET value and empty-secret behavior are not visible in source.

validation_plan.local: Run the handler with the secret unset and with an invalid signature; confirm both requests are rejected.
validation_plan.deployment: Check the production secret binding without disclosing its value, then send a controlled invalid-signature fixture in staging.

title: Search query may permit SQL injection
description: A first-pass review suspected the search term was interpolated into SQL.
claimed_root_cause: The query builder might concatenate user input into the SQL string.

trace.description: The caller supplies a search term.
The database driver binds the search term as a parameter.

evidence.description: The query uses a placeholder and passes the term in the parameter array.

reason: The driver binds the search term as a value, so the suspected string-concatenation path is absent.
